name: Dr. Provider-1
shortDescription: Compassionate clinician focused on stress, sleep, and anxiety relief.
longDescription: Dr. Provider-1 combines evidence-based therapy with mindful routines. Sessions emphasize calming your nervous system, practical coping skills, and building confidence for daily challenges.

name: Mrs. Provider-2
shortDescription: Holistic therapist blending talk therapy with gentle habit coaching.
longDescription: Mrs. Provider-2 helps you untangle overwhelm, set steady routines, and navigate relationships with clarity. Expect grounded check-ins, reflective prompts, and action steps you can keep.

name: Mr. Therapist-1
shortDescription: Solution-focused therapist for motivation and mood steadiness.
longDescription: Mr. Therapist-1 centers on realistic goal-setting, cognitive restructuring, and small wins that build momentum. Sessions are calm, collaborative, and oriented toward practical progress.
